name: Beatrice Manfrida
bioAdditions: Beatrice was born on 15 July 1687, daughter of Fabio Manfrida and Francesca Perri (S1). She married Giuseppe Putero in 1709 (S2) and was buried as his widow on 17 October 1765, aged about 78 (S3).
